notes.title: Hot 21 will be officially released this month!
notes.content:
hello everyone!

The long-awaited "Hot 21" will be officially released this month!
First of all, I will tell you the four roles we played for the first time. I hope you like them!
At present, the production team is still in a frantic rush. The specific release date will be notified as soon as it is confirmed.
Welcome to join the wish list and look forward to the official launch of Hot 21!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43589624/bf0c5e42ea2c9aaee34d2d4dd1c9210e3a6caa6c.jpg[/img]

This is a classic beauty Blackjack game, which ensures that you can use it easily.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43589624/2d27dbac540faeea4aedab895983dc98318b7e32.jpg[/img]

You can choose different beauties as your opponents according to your preferences. As long as you succeed in the challenge, you can let the girls dance a hot dance for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43589624/aab375cf8ae83b42f89e126fddbc577424e47976.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43589624/965b582bc98acd5fd0af6524fb7499feb7d64072.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43589624/053938c8f15cf10c32b842b2c174b491fd265d25.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43589624/f0834a75bd7e3fd65458d488d9ea072878639103.jpg[/img]

More importantly, as the challenge escalates, you can unlock more hot performances.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43589624/c9306f36b4136097f9689d7ae0ae3257be9093a1.png[/img]

There are four roles in the first round:

1：Ruby

2：Ciel

3：Nana

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43589624/6f57a154e9d95bcaad92688307d11456b9bc4c42.jpg[/img]

4：Fox

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43589624/eb8a8d029548ba7f5da208a130cb429c8d3fb205.jpg[/img]
